sentences.en: Algorithms sift through large data sets to detect unexpected patterns.
sentences.zh: 算法会筛选大量数据集以检测出乎意料的模式。

sentences.en: Did you sift the flour before you made the cookie batter?
sentences.zh: 你做饼干面团前把面粉筛过没有？

sentences.en: Sift the flour to remove the lumps.
sentences.zh: 把面粉筛一下去除疙瘩。
